title: Planet Tweaks V2.5.1 ULTRA — Autonomous Gemini AI PC Agent, Modern Windows 11 Dark Charcoal UI/UX Redesign
releaseNotes: Autonomous Gemini AI PC Agent: Multi-turn tool calling engine with 22 dedicated Windows diagnostic and optimization tools (13 read-only PC inspectors, 9 system-modifying tools). Interactive inline action approval cards with safety policy verification. Windows 11 Dark Charcoal UI/UX Redesign: Modern 1340x840 layout, 6 dynamic hardware telemetry cards (CPU, RAM, GPU, Storage, Network/OS, Timers), 8 Quick Actions, modern chat workspace with tool execution chips and thinking indicator.
